meta.coverage: October 2026 is covered systematically. Earlier cases (2014 to September 2026) were added on 12 November 2026 from three sources: Memorial's case cards for Ukrainians prosecuted by Russia, MIHR's monthly reviews of convicted civilians (April 2024 to October 2026), and verdicts posted by the occupation Zaporizhzhia regional court; and, added on 13 November 2026, people named or described in published reports and monitored pro-Russian media held in the TOT Insights research archive, including civilians detained without charge since 2014. No month before October 2026 is complete.
